'''Jaca Fatal''' was a [[Humanoid/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who was contracted by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] cult known as [[the Unmasked]] to deliver supplies to their [[Unmasked research station|research station]] in [[Unmasked research station|Sector R-4]]. Jacal was paid in research, astronomical, and navigation data, which caused him trouble with [[Mex Briggam]], as the data was gathered in part by a clone of the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|AI]] [[ARIA (AI)|ARIA]] known as [[EVE]], which led Mex to believe that Jaca was stealing Czerka corporate secrets. Mex kidnapped Jaca and tried to torture him for information, however he was interrupted by the [[Alliance Commander]]. Jaca worked out a deal with the commander; he would smuggle the commander onto the station and Jaca would go free. Jaca ended up saving the commander from the station's destruction.<ref name="TOR:ATftS" />
